messages.subject: occuRN output
parts:
Howdy
In the output of uccuRN does the 'abundance' represent N_i~Poisson(lamda_i) and the ranef output the detection probability for a single site? And if so I would use the mean of the ranef outputs as my estimate for abundance for all sites.

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] occuRN output
parts:
hi Graeme,

 the basic output reports parameters of lambda_i (mean, covariate effects) whereas ranef() produces the estimated posterior distribution of N_i  given the parameters fixed at their MLE.

 There are many examples of this on the list and also the new AHM book that just came out (see chapters 6, 7)

regards
andy
